newsitem.title: LATVIA: VENTSPILS RELOADINGS SLIGHTLY DOWN IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: VENTSPILS RELOADINGS SLIGHTLY DOWN IN MAY.

text.p: Reloadings of crude oil and oil products at Ventspils Nafta, one of the main outlets for Russian oil, slipped in May to two million tonnes from 2.1 mililion tonnes the month before, the company said on Wednesday.
Reloadings in May consisted of 1.2 million tonnes of crude and 684,000 tonnes of diesel, the company said in a statement.
Ventspils said lower volumes in April and May were due to lower demand in Europe for diesel with a sulphur content of 0.2 percent.
Ventspils said it reloaded 10.9 million tonnes of crude and products in the first five months of 1997, a rise of 300,000 tonnes against the same period the previous year.
